subject: SOC2 evidence request and subservice scope clarification for Altitude Health procurement
messages:
From: Amber Li <amber.li@altitudehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@altitudehealth.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: SOC2 evidence & subservice scope clarification — Altitude procurement request

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for picking this up — Altitude Health is running procurement for our LLM vendor selection and we need to validate SOC 2 coverage and subservice responsibilities before we can move to contract. Can you please provide the following by EOD Oct 7: 

- Redwood Inference SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) in PDF
- A signed bridge letter or statement if any portion of your controls relies on a cloud provider's report (we use Nimbus Cloud for our environment)
- Complete subprocessors listing with a brief mapping of responsibility (storage, compute, KMS, logging)
- Confirmation of whether Nimbus is treated as a carve-out (subservice organization carve-out) or if Redwood's report includes the provider controls (i.e., carve-in)
- Evidence for tenant isolation / VPC mapping (network segmentation summary) and KMS custody/CMK statements

I attached our procurement intake form for reference (Altitude_Procurement_Form.pdf). If a bridge letter is not available from the provider, we can accept a Redwood-issued narrative mapping that calls out the control ownership and what evidence we can request from Nimbus directly.

Point of contact for the compliance team is me (Amber Li, Amber.Li@altitudehealth.com) and procurement is on cc. This is time-boxed to keep our board review on schedule.

Thanks —
Amber Li
Head of IT Procurement
Altitude Health

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: Amber Li <amber.li@altitudehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 18:10:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence & subservice scope clarification — Altitude procurement request

Amber — thanks for the clear list and the intake form. We're happy to support Altitude's procurement timeline. A couple quick clarifying questions so we scope deliverables correctly: 

1) When you say Nimbus is the provider you use — is Altitude running in a customer-managed VPC on Nimbus (we expect so), or are you using a managed Nimbus tenant hosted by Redwood? That changes which provider controls you rely on.
2) Can you confirm the audit period you expect the bridge letter to cover? Your intake form references FY2025; we want to match the exact dates.
3) For subprocessors, do you want: (a) redactable contact-level info + SOC report links, or (b) full PDFs attached? We can provide both but need to coordinate NDAs for full provider docs.

I'm looping in Marissa (Security) to confirm our SOC2 packaging and evidence we can share, Mina (Legal) for any redaction/contract implications, and Karthik for the network segmentation note. I attached our internal checklist to help track items (SOC2-Request-Checklist.xlsx).

We should be able to produce: Redwood SOC2 Type II report (PDF), subprocessor list with responsibilities, and a responsibility-mapping document. Bridge letter from Nimbus may require a short lead time — we'll flag that immediately. Proposed internal deadline to get you full packet: Oct 6. Does that align?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Amber Li <amber.li@altitudehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@altitudehealth.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 08:44:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence & subservice scope clarification — Altitude procurement request

Thanks, Evelyn — quick clarifications below: 

- Altitude runs in our own Nimbus VPC and manages our account tenancy. We do not use a Redwood-hosted tenancy.
- Audit period we'd like covered is 2025-04-01 through 2026-03-31 (this is what our compliance team is baselining against).
- For subprocessors: initial packet should include a list with high-level scope (storage/compute/KMS/logging) + links to provider SOC reports where available. If you can attach provider SOCs that saves us time, but redacted links are OK for first pass.

I've attached the Nimbus provider SOC I found for our team to review (Nimbus_SOC2_2025.pdf). We still need Redwood to be explicit about whether the Redwood SOC2 excludes Nimbus controls (carve-out) or includes them. If Redwood's report is carve-out, we will need either: (a) a signed bridge letter from Nimbus covering the audit period above, or (b) a Redwood-led mapping that shows which controls we need to request evidence for from Nimbus and where Redwood retains control.

Procurement timeline: we need the packet by Oct 7 to get to our security review on Oct 12. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Amber

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Amber Li <amber.li@altitudehealth.com>, procurement@altitudehealth.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 11:35:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: SOC2 evidence & subservice scope clarification — Altitude procurement request

Team — forwarding Altitude's request (see thread below). Key asks: Redwood SOC2 Type II PDF, subprocessor list with responsibility mapping, explicit statement on provider carve-out vs carve-in for Nimbus covering 2025-04-01 to 2026-03-31, and network/KMS evidence. Attached: Altitude form, Nimbus SOC they provided, and our internal checklist.

Proposed owner/action items: 
- Marissa: prepare full SOC2 packet (Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf) and subprocessor list. Please include a table that maps control families to owner (Redwood|Nimbus|Customer).
- Mina: advise on any NDA/PII redaction needed before we share third-party PDFs.
- Karthik: produce a short network segmentation summary (1–2 pages) that describes tenant isolation, VPC boundaries, and logging retention for customer VPCs.
- Evelyn: I'll coordinate with Nimbus to request a bridge letter if required — I will also draft a Redwood narrative mapping doc as a fallback. 

Timeline: internal draft by Oct 4, final packet ready for customer by Oct 6 to meet their Oct 7 ask. If any of you cannot meet those dates, flag now.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
(On behalf of Redwood Compliance & Legal)
